cohort: The study involved thorough clinical and neurodevelopmental phenotyping of six individuals with de novo KMT2A variants, and a meta-analysis of individuals with KMT2A variants reported in the published literature.
finding: All six individuals with de novo KMT2A variants met clinical criteria for WSS, defining a specific neurodevelopmental phenotype including a subtype of ASD, and these variants were found to be significantly more prevalent than predicted, suggesting unrecognized WSS.
